stretchedres.subtitle: Switch a monitor to a stretched resolution — safely, with a 15-second auto-revert.
stretchedres.monitor.label: Monitor
stretchedres.monitor.fallback: The monitor you last used is not connected — {0} is selected instead.
stretchedres.monitor.none: No monitor could be detected — changes go to the primary display.

stretchedres.confirm.sub: Now showing {0} on {1}. Reverts to {2} automatically if you do not confirm.

stretchedres.status.desc.unknown: Could not read the current desktop resolution.
stretchedres.gpu.sub.none: Set your GPU to full-screen scaling
stretchedres.presets.title: Stretched presets
stretchedres.presets.intro: Each one applies its resolution to the monitor below temporarily — you get 15 seconds to confirm before it reverts on its own.
stretchedres.safety: If the screen goes black or unreadable, do not touch anything — the resolution reverts by itself after 15 seconds.
stretchedres.custom.title: Custom resolution
stretchedres.scaling.title: Make the GPU stretch the image
stretchedres.scaling.lead: A stretched resolution only fills the screen when your GPU scales it to the whole panel. {0}
stretchedres.scaling.vendor.nvidia: Your NVIDIA GPU handles this in the NVIDIA Control Panel.
stretchedres.scaling.vendor.amd: On your AMD GPU, enable GPU scaling in AMD Software.
stretchedres.scaling.vendor.intel: On Intel graphics, set the scale in the Intel Graphics Command Center.
stretchedres.scaling.vendor.none: Set your GPU's scaling mode to full-screen so the image fills the panel.
stretchedres.steps.nvidia.1: Right-click the desktop and open the NVIDIA Control Panel.
stretchedres.steps.nvidia.2: Go to Display → Adjust desktop size and position.
stretchedres.steps.nvidia.3: Pick the monitor you chose above, then set Scaling to Full-screen.
stretchedres.steps.nvidia.4: Set Perform scaling on to GPU, then click Apply.
stretchedres.steps.nvidia.5: Apply a stretched resolution above — it now fills the whole panel.
stretchedres.steps.amd.1: Open AMD Software → Display and pick the monitor you chose above.
stretchedres.steps.amd.2: Turn GPU Scaling on and set Scaling Mode to Full panel.
stretchedres.steps.intel.1: Open the Intel Graphics Command Center → Display and pick the monitor you chose above.
stretchedres.steps.intel.2: Under Scale, choose Full Screen and turn off Maintain Display Scaling.
stretchedres.steps.generic.1: Open your GPU's control panel (NVIDIA Control Panel, AMD Software or Intel Graphics Command Center).
stretchedres.steps.generic.2: Set the display scaling mode to full-screen and perform scaling on the GPU.
stretchedres.ark.title: ARK game resolution
stretchedres.ark.row.title: Write resolution to GameUserSettings.ini
stretchedres.ark.row.description: Optional — sets ARK's ResolutionSizeX/Y and windowed-fullscreen to match your chosen size. A timestamped backup is made first.
stretchedres.ark.note: Close ARK before writing — the game rewrites GameUserSettings.ini when it exits.
stretchedres.ark.toast.closefirst: Close ARK first — it rewrites GameUserSettings.ini when it exits.
